data.name: Florida Springs & Manatee Kayak or Paddleboard Adventure
data.headline: 4-day fully supported small-group adventure (private rooms + meals included)
data.description:
Florida Springs Adventure is a small-group, fully hosted getaway to Florida’s most iconic spring-fed waterways. Over four days we’ll paddle Silver Springs, Weeki Wachee, and Crystal River, with a snorkel tour included in Crystal River.

Expect crystal-clear water, wildlife, and that classic “old Florida” scenery—plus a smooth, stress-free experience because we handle the transportation, gear, and launch logistics so you can just show up and enjoy.

Wildlife note: Wildlife is wild, so sightings can’t be guaranteed—but Crystal River and these spring systems are known for consistent manatee activity, and it would be very unusual not to spot them during our time on the water.  Additionally, we can hope to see river otters, amazing fish, maybe even monkeys! 

This trip is capped at 12 guests and includes private-room lodging at Crystal River Plantation Resort.
data.highlights:
- Silver Springs “wildlife safari” paddle: crystal-clear water, birds, fish, and the famous monkeys
- Manatee country: paddle in waterways known for consistent manatee activity
- Weeki Wachee serenity paddle: peaceful, scenic, and unbelievably beautiful spring-fed water
- Crystal River springs exploration: paddle to check out multiple springs and clear-water pockets
- Snorkel tour included: experience Crystal River from below the surface, too
- We handle the logistics: transportation + gear/launch coordination (no shuttle stress)
- Small group + private rooms: premium comfort, better pacing, better experience
data.itinerary:
Day 1 (Thu Feb 12): Arrive + Crystal River + Sunset Welcome Social
TPA pickup, check-in, optional afternoon paddle, then a sunset welcome social.

Day 2 (Fri Feb 13): Silver Springs (Full Day)
A full-day paddle at Silver Springs with a packed lunch on the water. Group dinner included.

Day 3 (Sat Feb 14): Weeki Wachee (Full Day) + Free Evening
Our featured paddle day. Breakfast + lunch included. Dinner on your own in Crystal River.

Day 4 (Sun Feb 15): Snorkel + Depart
Morning snorkel, check-out, and return to TPA.

  - Late pickup: 5:30 pm ($100 per person, limited seats)
- Meals:
  - Welcome social with food + two drinks
  - Breakfasts (with SURFit “upgrade” items)
  - Packed lunches for paddle days
  - One hosted group dinner
  - All meals except Saturday dinner

Payment & Cancellation Policy
Payment:
A $300 deposit per person is required to reserve your spot.
Full payment is due by January 12, 2026.
Cancellation:

data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking your spot on the Crystal River Springs & Manatee Experience! We’re excited to share this adventure with you. Please review the important details below:

##Meeting Point:
Tampa International Airport (TPA) or the Crystal River Plantation Resort
If meeting at TPA, please arrive by 1:00 pm
If meeting at the hotel, check-in is available after 2:00 PM.

##Accommodation:
All guests will have thier own room and bathroom at the newly renovated Crystal River Plantation Resort. 

##What to Bring:
Comfortable clothes for paddling and relaxing
Swimsuit, towel, water shoes or sandals
Sun protection (hat, sunglasses, reef-safe sunscreen)
Reusable water bottle
Personal toiletries and medications
Rain jacket or light layers (weather can vary)
Camera or phone for photos
Small daypack
Any favorite snacks

##What’s Included:
All paddling equipment, safety gear, meals, and guided activities
Airport transfers (if meeting at TPA)
Accommodation (3 nights)
Welcome Social
Transportation to All Paddle Locations
Breakfast, Lunch and Most Dinners

##What’s Not Included:
Airfare to/from Tampa
Alcoholic beverages
Travel insurance
Guide gratuities
Personal expenses

##Payment Reminder:
Full payment is due by January 12, 2026. You’ll receive a reminder as the date approaches.
Cancellation Policy:
Cancel before Jan 12: Refund minus $50 fee.
After Jan 12: No refunds, but you can transfer your spot to another SURFit activity or future trip, subject to availability.

##We’ll Be Reaching Out!

To make sure you have the best possible adventure, we’ll contact you via email soon to get to know you a little better. We’ll ask about:
Dietary preferences or food allergies
Paddling experience and skill level
Rooming preferences (and if you’re traveling with someone)
Any special requirements or questions
Our goal is to make sure everyone is comfortable, well-prepared, and ready for an unforgettable time!

##Final Details:
A detailed trip itinerary and packing list will be sent 2 weeks before your departure.
If you have dietary restrictions or special needs, you can also let us know anytime at info@surfitusa.com.

##Questions?

Contact us at 941-952-8245 or info@surfitusa.com. We’re here to help!
